title: Run cargo-audit directly in the CI audit job
description: Run cargo-audit directly in the CI audit job
no_spec_change_rationale: rustsec/audit-check v2.0.0 turns any unmaintained or unsound warning into a Checks API report whose update returns 404 (Not Found), so the required audit check fails with 0 vulnerabilities (seen on CorvidLabs/fledge#547). Running cargo audit directly keeps the same gate: it fails on vulnerabilities and only prints warnings.
acceptance_criteria: The CI audit job installs cargo-audit and runs cargo audit after cargo generate-lockfile, with no rustsec/audit-check step; the job still fails on any vulnerability advisory; unmaintained, unsound or yanked warnings are printed without failing the job; the job id and name stay audit so the required check and the corvid-pet and attest needs are unchanged
